nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable holding the computed NFT value; written by constructor and performUpkeep.
Public uint32 state variable (ERC20 token price in USD) initialised to 319; writable by arbitrary external caller through setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
Public uint32 state variable counting sold NFTs, initialised to 94; writable by arbitrary external caller through setSoldNFTCnt and used as divisor.
Public uint16 state variable (target day, default 3) compared against parsed block.timestamp day in checkUpkeep.
Public uint16 state variable (target hour, default 9) compared against parsed block.timestamp hour in checkUpkeep.
Constructor initialising zNFTValue to 67872.
External setter with no access control that overwrites soldNFTCnt, the divisor of the value formula.
External setter with no access control that overwrites cpERC20TokenPriceUSD, the multiplier of the value formula.
External setter with no access control that overwrites dateDay, the target upkeep day.
External setter with no access control that overwrites dateHour, the target upkeep hour.
External view KeeperCompatibleInterface check that parses block.timestamp and compares day/hour against dateDay/dateHour.
External KeeperCompatibleInterface perform function recomputing zNFTValue = (20000 * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD) / soldNFTCnt with unrestricted caller.
Public pure helper determining whether a given year is a leap year.
Public pure helper computing the number of leap years before a given year (year -= 1 then arithmetic).
Public pure helper returning the number of days in a month for a given year, delegating to isLeapYear.
Internal pure date parser that decomposes an epoch timestamp into the _DateTime struct fields using repeated accumulation/subtraction arithmetic.
Public pure function deriving the year from a timestamp with a while loop that decrements secondsAccountedFor and year.
Public pure wrapper returning parseTimestamp(timestamp).month.
Public pure wrapper returning parseTimestamp(timestamp).day.
Public pure function returning (timestamp / 60 / 60) % 24.
Public pure function returning (timestamp / 60) % 60.
Public pure function returning timestamp % 60.
Public pure function returning (timestamp / DAY_IN_SECONDS + 4) % 7.
Block timestamp supplied by the miner/validator; used as the sole time source for the upkeep scheduling logic.
Arithmetic expression (20000 * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD) / soldNFTCnt; division can revert when soldNFTCnt is set to zero and depends on caller-controlled state.
Arithmetic accumulation/subtraction in parseTimestamp (secondsAccountedFor additions and leapYearsBefore(dt.year) - leapYearsBefore(ORIGIN_YEAR)) that can underflow/revert on extreme timestamps.
Arithmetic decrement loop in getYear (year -= 1 and secondsAccountedFor -= YEAR_IN_SECONDS/LEAP_YEAR_IN_SECONDS) that can underflow/revert.

uint256 running accumulator of seconds consumed while parsing the date.
uint256 temporary buffer holding the leap-year count for the parsed year.
uint8 loop counter used for month and day iteration.
uint256 temporary holding DAY_IN_SECONDS * getDaysInMonth(i, dt.year).

edges.reason: checkUpkeep reads block.timestamp (untrusted, miner-influenceable) to decide whether upkeep is needed, making upkeep scheduling timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp flows into parseTimestamp to derive the day/hour fields used by the upkeep condition.
checkUpkeep invokes parseTimestamp(block.timestamp) to build the _DateTime struct.
checkUpkeep reads dateDay to compare it with the parsed dt.day.
checkUpkeep reads dateHour to compare it with the parsed dt.hour.
parseTimestamp calls getYear(timestamp) to fill dt.year.
parseTimestamp calls getDaysInMonth for month and day iteration.
getDaysInMonth calls isLeapYear(year) for February handling.
parseTimestamp calls getHour(timestamp) to fill dt.hour.
parseTimestamp calls getMinute(timestamp) to fill dt.minute.
parseTimestamp calls getSecond(timestamp) to fill dt.second.
parseTimestamp calls getWeekday(timestamp) to fill dt.weekday.
getYear calls leapYearsBefore for the current year and for ORIGIN_YEAR.
getYear calls isLeapYear inside the decrement while loop.
parseTimestamp calls leapYearsBefore(dt.year) and leapYearsBefore(ORIGIN_YEAR).
parseTimestamp executes unchecked-able subtractive/accumulative arithmetic on secondsAccountedFor and leap-year counts.
The arithmetic operation writes/reads the secondsAccountedFor accumulator, which can underflow/revert.
getYear performs `year -= 1` and `secondsAccountedFor -= ...` arithmetic that can underflow.
The decrement operation mutates the local year variable, which can underflow for small inputs.
performUpkeep executes (20000 * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD) / soldNFTCnt, a multiplication and division over caller-controlled state.
The division arithmetic result is written into zNFTValue, so a zero/reverted divisor or overflowed product corrupts or blocks the value update.
performUpkeep reads cpERC20TokenPriceUSD as the multiplier of the value formula.
performUpkeep reads soldNFTCnt as the divisor of the value formula.
setSoldNFTCnt writes the caller-supplied value into the soldNFTCnt state variable.
The cnt parameter is stored directly into soldNFTCnt with no validation.
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD writes the caller-supplied value into cpERC20TokenPriceUSD.
The price parameter is stored directly into cpERC20TokenPriceUSD with no validation.
setDateDay writes the caller-supplied value into dateDay.
The _day parameter is stored directly into dateDay with no validation.
setDateHour writes the caller-supplied value into dateHour.
The _hour parameter is stored directly into dateHour with no validation.
The constructor initialises zNFTValue to 67872.
performData parameter is referenced (and ignored) inside performUpkeep.
checkData parameter is echoed back as performData by checkUpkeep.
The year parameter controls the modulo checks in isLeapYear.
The year parameter is decremented and divided in leapYearsBefore.
The month parameter selects the days-in-month branch.
The year parameter is forwarded to isLeapYear inside getDaysInMonth.
The timestamp parameter is the input decomposed by parseTimestamp.
The timestamp parameter is converted into a year by getYear.
The timestamp parameter is forwarded from getMonth into parseTimestamp.
The timestamp parameter is forwarded from getDay into parseTimestamp.
The timestamp parameter is arithmetically reduced in getHour.
The timestamp parameter is arithmetically reduced in getMinute.
The timestamp parameter is arithmetically reduced in getSecond.
The timestamp parameter is arithmetically reduced in getWeekday.
getMonth delegates to parseTimestamp(timestamp).
getDay delegates to parseTimestamp(timestamp).
The dt struct is the return value assembled and written by parseTimestamp.
The secondsAccountedFor accumulator is repeatedly updated inside parseTimestamp.
The buf temporary is written and consumed when computing the year offset in parseTimestamp.
The i loop counter drives the month and day loops inside parseTimestamp.
The secondsInMonth temporary is used in the month loop comparison of parseTimestamp.
The upkeepNeeded boolean is computed and returned by checkUpkeep.
The performData local is assigned from checkData and returned by checkUpkeep.
The numLeapYears local is computed and consumed inside getYear.
The secondsAccountedFor local drives the while loop condition in getYear.
The local year variable is decremented and finally returned by getYear.
The secondsAccountedFor accumulator is the operand of the risky addition/subtraction series in parseTimestamp.
